capabilities: Create .board files that define Kanban, table, and cards views
Group notes into columns by a trigger frontmatter property
Update a note's property by dragging its Kanban card between columns
Scope boards to the whole vault, sibling notes, or a specific folder
Show properties, file metadata, formulas, or note-body slices on cards
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view and edit notes as a Kanban board driven by their property values.
summary: Property-driven board plugin that renders Kanban, table, and card views of notes grouped by a frontmatter property, stored as .board files.
